value: With the top piece returned, Anthion explains the danger that he could not see before. The Veiled Blade split Valthalak’s amulet into three parts out of greed, not knowing that it held much of the warlock’s soul. The curse followed. Anthion asks the seeker to find Bodley, who can guide the search for the other pieces. At last, Anthion believes he may rest; his part in the company’s wrong has become a plea to set it right.
editorNote: Research status: the accessible quest and manual pages reproduce in-game evidence but are secondary mirrors. The manual is Bodley’s perspective. Alternate class/faction targets are editorially ordered and are not one canonical adventurer’s route.
